questions.q: What name did Lady Anne give Black Beauty?
choices: Black Auster
Baron
Darkie
Max
questions.evidence: She chose me for her horse, and named me "Black Auster".

questions.q: What kind of rider was Lady Anne?
choices: A perfect horsewoman, gay and gentle
A nervous beginner
A cruel rider who used a whip
A rider who never went out
questions.evidence: She was a perfect horsewoman, and as gay and gentle as she was beautiful.

questions.q: What had Ginger told Beauty about Lizzie?
choices: She was rather nervous
She was very lazy
She was the fastest horse in England
She was blind in one eye

questions.q: Why did Blantyre beg Lady Anne not to ride Lizzie?
choices: He thought Lizzie was too nervous to be safe for a lady
He wanted to ride Lizzie himself
Lizzie was lame that day
Lizzie had never worn a side-saddle
questions.evidence: she is too nervous for a lady

Because Lady Anne felt ill
To have Lizzie's shoe fixed
To deliver a basket of food
questions.evidence: Would they ask this question for her at Dr. Ashley's, and bring the answer?

A train whistle blew

Broke the gate and chased her alone
Lay down in the road
